instruction: Open or import the initial file(s) from the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\thread_plate.step. Drill and thread mill the six M8 pilot holes in C:\Users\User\Desktop\thread_plate.step. Thread Milling must reach Z=0.000 mm and include arcs or a helical approximation. Tool definitions: T1 is a 6.8 mm drill for M8 pilot holes; T2 is an M8 thread mill. Use the SolidCAM CAM-Part, Coordinate System, Stock, Tool Table, operation, simulation/verify, and post-processing dialogs as needed, then save the required output file(s) to the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-18.nc.
